Technical, data and background due diligence of a target: ownership, people, assets and red flags, each finding with its source.

The concept behind it: [Due diligence](@/glossary/due-diligence.md).

Services that draw on it: [Corporate and counterparty due diligence](@/services/due-diligence.md) and [M&A pre-deal screening and analysis](@/services/m-and-a.md).

Practised with: [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Playwright](@/glossary/playwright.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [Shell](@/glossary/shell.md), [Tailwind CSS](@/glossary/tailwind-css.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md) and [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md).

Public work whose own words show it: [vomaste.cz](https://github.com/korczis/vomaste.cz).

It was applied in client work in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group; the use cases below give the principle and the intent, without names or numbers.

How to read this page: the definition is the experience vocabulary's; the services, technologies, public [repositories](@/glossary/repository.md) and use cases are derived and each links to its page.
